name: wenext
description: Finds the first users for what you built. Reads your code, finds people on Reddit and X who are describing the problem it solves right now, drafts replies in your voice, and publishes from your own accounts only after you approve.

interface.shortDescription: Find the first users for what you built
interface.longDescription: In about five minutes Wenext reads your code, finds people on Reddit and X who are describing the problem your product solves right now, and prepares replies in your voice. You approve each one with a click, nothing goes out without you, and it measures what happens: replies, upvotes, removals and GitHub stars. It keeps a memory of what worked, so each week starts from the last. Requires the Wenext stack running on your machine.
defaultPrompt: Find my first users: read my code, find people who need it, draft replies in my voice.
Turn what I just shipped into an update post.
How did my replies do this week?
